steps.title: Goal
steps.content: Help the farmer plant pumpkins and give them extra space to grow! Plant and water pumpkins in a checkered pattern using 2 loops and 2 variables.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.content: From the {Loops}[category-loops] category in the Toolbox, add a {count with (i)[block-variables] from (1) to (10) by (1)}[block-loops] block inside the {begin}[block-begin] block.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.content: From the {Farm}[category-farm] category, add a {plant (sunflower) at row (1) column (1)}[block-plant] block and place it inside the {repeat (10) times}[block-loops] block. Inside the plant block, change the crop type from sunflower to pumpkin, so the block reads {plant (pumpkin) at row (1) column (1)}[block-plant].

steps.title: Step 3
steps.content: In the {Variables}[category-variables] category in the Toolbox, press the Create Variable button. Name the variable “row number”.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.content: Inside the {count with (i)[block-variables] from (1) to (10) by (1)}[block-loops] block, change the variable “i” to the new variable “row number”. Change the number 10 to 3, so the block reads {count with (row number)[block-variables] from (1) to (3) by (1)}[block-loops].

steps.title: Step 5
steps.content: From the {Variables}[category-variables] category, add the {row number}[block-variables] variable block into the “row” field of the plant block, replacing the number 1. The block should now read {plant (pumpkin) at row (row number)[block-variables] column (1)}[block-plant].

steps.title: Step 6
steps.content: Press the {Run All Days}[button-run-all-days] button. Check that crops have been planted in all 3 rows.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.content: From the {Loops}[category-loops]  category in the Toolbox, add a {count with (i)[block-variables] from (1) to (10) by (1)}[block-loops] block inside the {count with (row number)[block-variables] from (1) to (3) by (1)}[block-loops] block that is already there.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.content: Move the {plant (pumpkin) at row (row number)[block-variables] column (1)}[block-plant] block to inside the inner {count with (i)[block-variables] from (1) to (10) by (1)}[block-loops] block.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.content: From the {Variables}[category-variables] category, add the {row number}[block-variables] variable block into the “row” field of the plant block, replacing the number 1. The block should now read {plant (pumpkin) at row (row number)[block-variables] column (1)}[block-plant].

steps.title: Step 10
steps.content: Inside the inner {count with (i)[block-variables] from (1) to (10) by (1)}[block-loops] block, change the variable “i” to the new variable “column number”. Change the number 10 to 3, so the block reads {count with (column number)[block-variables] from (1) to (3) by (1)}[block-loops].

steps.title: Step 11
steps.content: From the {Variables}[category-variables] category, add the {column number}[block-variables] variable block into the “column” field of the plant block, replacing the number 1. The block should now read {plant (pumpkin) at row (row number)[block-variables] column (column number)[block-variables]}[block-plant].

steps.title: Step 12
steps.content: Press the {Run All Days}[button-run-all-days] button. Check that crops have been planted in all 9 farm plots.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.content: From the {Logic}[category-logic] category in the Toolbox, add an {if, do}[block-logic] block inside the {count with (column number)[block-variables] from (1) to (3) by (1)}[block-loops] block, and move the {plant (pumpkin)}[block-plant] block inside of the {if, do}[block-logic] block.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.content:
From the {Math}[category-math] category, add a {(0) is even}[block-math] block inside the empty field on the if block, so it reads {if (0) is even, do}[block-logic]. 
Then, from the {Math}[category-math] category, add a {(1) + (1)}[block-math] block inside the {(0) is even}[block-math] block.

steps.title: Step 15
steps.content:
From the {Variables}[category-variables] category, add the {row number}[block-variables] block, into the {(1) + (1)}[block-math] block, replacing the number 1. 
From the {Variables}[category-variables] category, add the {column number}[block-variables] block, into the {(row number)[block-variables] + (1)}[block-math] block, replacing the number 1. 
The block should now read {if (row number)[block-variables] + (column number)[block-variables] is even}[block-logic].

steps.title: Step 16
steps.content: Press the {Run All Days}[button-run-all-days] button. Check that crops have been planted in a checkered pattern.

steps.title: Step 17
steps.content: Go further: Add more blocks so the planted crops get watered and then grow the plants until they are mature and harvest them!
